hosts.note: The allowlist's allowed-host constant (HostAllowlist.DISCORD_HOST); the only host the app is allowed to contact. The app builds URLs only under https://discord.com/api/v9. Also the sign-in screen's WebView filter (SignInHosts.HOSTS) and the capture's API host (SignInCapture.API_HOST), B34 Form A

The sign-in screen's WebView filter (SignInHosts.HOSTS, B34 Form A): Discord's own CDN host (cdn.discordapp.com: avatars and icons the login page shows); admitted with its subdomains for the page only, never by the app's own client, whose allowlist stays discord.com alone

The sign-in screen's WebView filter (SignInHosts.HOSTS, B34 Form A): Discord's own media host (media.discordapp.net, images.discordapp.net); admitted with its subdomains for the page only, never by the app's own client

The sign-in screen's WebView filter (SignInHosts.HOSTS, B34 Form A): the captcha Discord's login may show (hCaptcha's frames, scripts and images); admitted with its subdomains for the page only, never by the app's own client
